templates.name: Buy & Sell 1m -5% Stop-Loss
templates.description: This strategy runs a regular Buy&Sell 1 minute bot in loop. Plus, if you lose more than 5%, the bot sells everything and terminates.

templates.name: Bullish Trend Following
templates.description: Uses EMA crossover strategy to identify bullish trends. Enters on EMA 9/26 golden cross and exits on death cross or when RSI becomes overbought.

templates.name: RSI Oversold/Overbought
templates.description: Simple RSI strategy that buys when RSI drops below 30 (oversold) and sells when RSI goes above 70 (overbought). Good for ranging markets.

templates.name: MACD + Bollinger Bands
templates.description: Combines MACD crossover signals with Bollinger Band squeeze for high-probability entries.

templates.name: Trailing Stop Scalper
templates.description: Quick scalping strategy using EMA crossover with tight trailing stop. Designed for volatile pairs on short timeframes.

templates.name: Webhook Signal Bot
templates.description: Receives buy/sell signals from external sources (TradingView, custom scripts) via webhook. No built-in indicators.
